notes.title: Version 3.30 : Hot off the Iron!
notes.notes:
[h1]IT'S FINALLY HERE![/h1][p]Thank you everyone for waiting so patiently. As promised, the big update has finally been posted! Without any ado, let's jump right into what's new![/p][p][/p][h2]Main Features[/h2][list][*][p]Hot new menu design, including refreshed sprites, better organization, and lots of new settings![/p][/*][*][p]The forging minigame has been completely overhauled. New tools, a fancy new layout, and all new sprites![/p][/*][*][p]Order scroll requests have new alloy and craft requirement variants. The more specific the request, the more extra coin you'll earn![/p][/*][*][p][b]Experimental localization is now implemented!!![/b] You can now play the game in English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Polski, Português Brasileiro, Русский, 简体中文, or 日本語 
[i](please note that some translations are still missing, the localization is actively being worked on)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]A huge shoutout to everyone who has contributed to the localization effort![/h3][p]As stated above, [u]there are going to be some missing translations still[/u]. The localization project is a big [b]big[/b] undertaking, and it's going to take a lot more work until it's perfect, but we're off to a [b][i]great start[/i][/b]! Please be patient while I work on finishing the implementation and while my trusty translators work on the new content that still needs translating. [b]Polska Gurom![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/d78b7cc51ae21b67270db42cc212bda763c14d91.png"][/img][/p][p]But wait, [i]that isn't all!~[/i] Get ready to be spoiled, here's everything else that's been added to the game since the last big update![/p][p][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]new pegs added to the shop, can be used to store tools in the background layer[/b][/p][/*][*][p]discovering a new alloy will now display a banner & play a fun little tune[/p][/*][*][p][b]you can now pin alloy recipes from the journal[/b][/p][/*][*][p]discovering alloys will now reveal a fun fact about them in the journal[/p][/*][*][p][b]window resizing is now properly supported (no more black bars on the sides)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]new save name suffixes (previously only "Smithery" could be used)[/p][/*][*][p]new gameplay setting to prevent the crucible from tipping over (unless using the tipper)[/p][/*][*][p]new 'dim-assist' setting darkens the background to help increase visibility of items[/p][/*][*][p]added setting that will sync the color of ores and their ingot counterparts[/p][/*][*][p]new setting can disable the automatic camera slowdown that occurs when holding "heavy" objects[/p][/*][*][p]new setting to control the speed of edge-panning[/p][/*][*][p]new settings to disable backgrounds and/or fancy liquids (can help improve performance)[/p][/*][*][p]several new chatling commands[/p][/*][*][p]the bucket now has a customizable label[/p][/*][*][p]cages and balls can now be purchased from the shop for chatlings[/p][/*][*][p]a new art piece has been added to the shop[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/ec1fdc2764e9c3e45b75e86e189aa093e500657b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]adjusted values of all metals to reduce vast price variances[/b][/p][/*][*][p]improved player character's penmanship (new font to support localization)[/p][/*][*][p]gameplay settings are now saved per-save file rather than globally across all save files[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted stone spawn rate and size frequency[/p][/*][*][p]metal now emits light when it is very hot[/p][/*][*][p]metal now glows different colors depending on how hot it is[/p][/*][*][p]added over 40 chatling appearance variants[/p][/*][*][p]a small fist is now displayed when chatlings grab something[/p][/*][*][p]updated various sprites and sounds[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/aadfc9f4d25493a660cf8a6bb80f386fa65f3036.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]implemented many many changes to help reduce lag on different systems[/b][/p][/*][*][p]you can no longer make "super-ingots" by placing the mold inside the crucible[/p][/*][*][p]improved functionality of cranks (they should stutter less often while being used)[/p][/*][*][p]lazy-bones should be much less finicky (no more zooming when you meant to crank)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed various chatling related crashes[/p][/*][*][p]added limits to certain chatling commands[/p][/*][*][p]updated chatling goops to no longer be burning hot[/p][/*][*][p]implemented new catch for potential save file errors[/p][/*][*][p]fixed various descriptions & spellings[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Plus a whole bunch of little things here and there that I've already forgotten about.[/p][p][/p][h2]Known Bugs[/h2][p]Some bugs didn't get squashed, so you'll probably encounter these:[/p][list][*][p]Resizing the window while in the main menu stretches the game (resize it again once you've loaded into your save to fix this.)[/p][/*][*][p]Audio only plays from the left side in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Plenty of text in the game is not translated properly yet, but most of the important stuff is.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Performance Issues[/h2][p]Despite my best efforts, I still get reports of some players experiencing terrible lag while playing, despite being able to run other games fine. Please be assured I am constantly looking into this and trying different things to resolve the issue, but I haven't seemed to fix it for everyone just yet. This update contains a LOT of changes that should help improve performance, but if not, please let me know so I can keep tackling the issue.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/334f9dbb482f56ecc1c8d90855306048141c0a90.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Banner[/h2][p]You may have noticed, the game has a new Library banner! Huge thank you to Blaffski for making it, it came out absolutely amazing. Check them out on their [url="https://twitter.com/Blaffeeyvhs"]Twitter[/url] or [url="https://www.twitch.tv/blaffski"]Twitch[/url] if you have the chance, they're an amazing artist and you should buy art from them.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's Next?[/h2][p]That's all for now! Thank you again for waiting while I cooked up this update. I'm the only developer on this project, so sometimes things take a while and life gets in the way of progress, but rest assured I still have a lot of plans for Alnico Smithery. I don't know when the next update will be ready, but it's gonna be pretty dang neat if everything goes according to plan. No spoilers though! You'll just have to wait and see what I have in store.[/p][p]If you haven't yet, I strongly encourage you to join the community Discord if you want to keep up to date on the state of the game and my other projects! It's also a great place to ask questions, troubleshoot, and make friends who all like the silly smithing game.[/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/555169dc94cd4deff4404f084dd89b643557bd9d.png"][/img][/p][p]Until next time, I hope you enjoy the new content. Adiós! [/p][p][b]-Pinapl[/b][/p]

notes.title: Early Access 3.14 Hotfix
notes.notes:
I got a report that someone's saves were wiped after updating and we can't have that.

I can't fix what's gone, but going forward I have implemented a secondary error catcher that should grab your save file and push it into a different file if something goes wrong so I can diagnose and fix it afterwards. 

Apologies that my game decided it hates you, I'm teaching it more love and care. Hopefully this error was a very rare occurance and never happens again.]
-Pinapl

notes.title: Beta 2.68 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h1]I've gotten word![/h1] It's been told to me from the highest mountains and the deepest seas! There is an error! And I think I fixed it! 
While I was at it, i've attempted to make the click & drag physics more stable[u] so your ore can stop exploding out of your buckets[/u]. Here's hoping, thanks for all the reports gamers!

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Click & Drag should be more stable / less jittery now
[*] Clicking objects will now prioritize the closest object to the cursor
[*] The hotter the object, the faster you will let go
[*] Minor tutorial adjustments
[/list][h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the error everyone got upon starting/loading a game
[*] Fixed a tutorial-related error that could occur between loads
[*] Reduced the size of the background sprites in a feeble attempt to reduce lag when zoomed out
[/list]

I completely re-wrote the code that handles grabbing and moving objects, so [b]there are likely to be bugs[/b]. Please let me know if you encounter any, but I hope it works better than ever! [b]Happy smithing![/b]
-Pinapl

notes.title: Beta 2.41 Patch
notes.notes:
Letting you all zoom out was an incredibly bigger headache than it warrented, so you better enjoy it to the fullest! Note: zooming all the way out seems to reduce framerate slightly, unsure why.
Bugs eliminated, stuff added. here's the damage report:

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rehauled camera controls, including the ability to zoom out
[*] Added new settings & a "continue" button to the menu
[*] Info popups re-worked and lots of new ones added
[*] New sounds added
[*] New texture for below the mine
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tongs reworked to be better tongs than ever before
[*] Metal & bits are now grabbable from inside the crucible if below a certain height (1/2 the crucible's depth)
[*] Some existing sounds have been re-balanced or changed
[*] Ore now dispenses from the refinery faster if it is smaller
[*] Updated collision beneath the refinery
[*] Opacity of edge-panning zone reduced
[*] Tooltips now always show metal names
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tooltips no longer appear if the setting isn't enabled
[*] Cobwebs won't spawn on items if they have weird rotations
[*] Fiddled with various code to try and improve performance
[/list]

As we approach the early access release date, I am focusing on fixing any bugs and improving existing content. With this in mind however, as always any and all feedback is very appreciated.
Consider joining the discord community to keep up to date with the game's progress, thanks!
